Title: Misspelling in comments

Body:
https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/32f469idiscovery-bsp/blob/6e51dbf6865ce35dafc75e3a51d296b94285e7f1/stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c#L172

"Ititilization" is used multiple times in this comment where initialization was meant.

Comments:
[Jah-yee - 2026-05-17T22:49:27Z]
PR #4 submitted with the typo fix (ititialization -> initialization in LCD comments).

[ASAHSTM - 2026-05-21T08:58:26Z]
Hello,

Thank you for your report.
This issue has been tracked internally.

With Regards,

[ASAHSTM - 2026-05-21T08:58:45Z]
ST Internal Reference: CDM0062817

Title: Conditional Error in function DSI_IO_ReadCmd from stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c

Body:
Hello,

Spotted minor error here, that would create incorrect debugging feedback mainly :
[stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c/int32_t DSI_IO_ReadCmd(uint32_t Reg, uint8_t *pData, uint32_t Size)](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/32f469idiscovery-bsp/blob/f79918e76de5310aad28ebf33365f902f51df85b/stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c#L1346)

inside the if condition it shouldn't be :
c
if(HAL_DSI_Read(&hdsi_eval, LCD_Driver_ID, pData, Size, DSI_DCS_SHORT_PKT_READ, Reg, pData)!= HAL_OK)

but more:
c
if(HAL_DSI_Read(&hdsi_eval, LCD_Driver_ID, pData, Size, DSI_DCS_SHORT_PKT_READ, Reg, pData)== HAL_OK)

Bye.

Comments:
[ASEHSTM - 2025-02-04T16:12:30Z]
Hello @JoCake,

Thank you for your report.
ST Internal Reference: 202226

With Regards,

[ASEHSTM - 2025-02-25T13:36:24Z]
Fixed in: aa9a1770a2dc7f30d2ba2d45d62124a94cf89d54
